units: Framework is organized around a vertical causal stack studying how feedback propagates through increasingly deep adaptation layers.
A viable adaptive system is asserted to require reality to influence current state and mechanisms responsible for future change.
Reality -> Correction -> Representation -> Mechanism -> Mechanism Generator.
Reality provides external consequences independent of the system's internal model.
Examples of reality signals: task outcomes, environmental changes, failed predictions and unexpected consequences.
Reality is described as the source of selection pressure.
Correction is the ability of reality to modify the system.
External evidence must maintain causal access to processes responsible for future adaptation.
Without correction, errors may persist, internal consistency can replace external accuracy, and optimization can continue while disconnecting from reality.
Representation is the coordinate system through which the system understands and acts.
Core loop: R -> Omega -> C -> A -> R'.
Persistent residuals that cannot be resolved in the current representation may trigger structural expansion.
Mechanisms are active processes that transform states.
Traditional state/parameter modification is distinguished from modifying the adaptation process itself.
Mechanism-generator layer is the ability to modify mechanisms responsible for future adaptation, changing how solutions are generated rather than only solutions.
Causal Transition Condition is source-described as investigating when the transition to mechanism-generator change occurs.
D_c: consequence penetration into adaptive machinery; C_e: selection pressure on structural change; A_c: successful adaptation becoming substrate for future adaptation.
Reality/Correction layer is source-mapped to Adaptive Stability Framework.
Representation layer is source-mapped to Recursive Representation Expansion.
Mechanism Transition layer is source-mapped to CTRE / Causal Transition Condition.
Mechanism Generator layer is source-mapped to Recursive Adaptive Dynamics.
Selection Across Systems layer is source-mapped to Ancestor Architecture.
Intelligence is proposed to increase when feedback can reach progressively deeper adaptive layers.
Does reality only change system behavior, or can it change how the system changes?
The vertical layer ordering is source-proposed; causal necessity, completeness and ordering are not empirically established here.
E*, C_rev and causal access are not assigned intervention semantics, estimator or threshold.
Persistent residuals are not uniquely diagnostic of representational insufficiency; alternative failure loci are not discriminated.
D_c, C_e, A_c and G_V lack measurement scales, estimators and an operational success criterion for the causal-transition arrow.
Module labels are not resolved here to immutable corpus endpoints and source layer assignment does not emit Program Map edges.
The claim that intelligence increases as feedback reaches deeper layers has no metric, comparison protocol or reported result on this frozen surface.
Source states the Adaptive Intelligence Framework is implemented as a collection of research modules, each exploring a causal-stack layer.
Reality -> Correction -> Representation -> Mechanism -> Mechanism Generator -> Selection Across Systems.
Adaptive Stability Framework is described as studying whether adaptive systems remain coupled to reality as internal complexity increases.
Named core primitives: Theta reality permeability, C correction capacity, n* corrigibility horizon.
Can feedback continue modifying a system as the system recursively changes?
Adaptive Stability Framework is source-mapped to repository slug `adaptive-stability-framework`.
REE is described as testing representation-space expansion when existing representations fail.
Can persistent residuals cause structural expansion rather than continued optimization in a failed coordinate system?
REE layer is source-mapped to repository slugs `ree` and `ctre_simulator`.
Causal Transition Condition is described as the boundary between adapting within a mechanism and modifying the mechanism itself.
Observable transition is specified as persistent structural residual, generation of a new adaptation rule, and persistence/influence of that rule on future adaptation.
Recursive Adaptive Dynamics is described as studying systems where adaptation becomes substrate for future adaptation.
Can a system modify the processes responsible for generating future improvements?
Ancestor Architecture is described as extending adaptive intelligence to multi-agent systems and downstream adaptive capacity.
Core metric: Delta A_residual > 0; successful system leaves greater capability after removal.
Source asserts causal/dependency direction: Adaptive Stability -> Grounded Recursive Adaptation -> REE -> Causal Transition Condition -> RAD -> Ancestor Architecture.
Source assertion only; no Cerebro edge emitted.
Source states the repositories are not independent projects.
Source states the repositories represent different measurement points along the same adaptive process.
How does a system move from optimizing within a fixed mechanism to modifying mechanisms responsible for future adaptation?
Calling the framework 'implemented as a collection of research modules' is a program-status assertion; R25 frozen head contains no executable implementation or run artifacts.
Theta, correction capacity and corrigibility horizon are named primitives but no estimators, units or local measurement protocol are provided here.
Mechanism-space G and criterion for structural expansion versus ordinary feature/model update remain unspecified locally.
Persistent residual, generated-rule novelty, persistence and future influence lack thresholds/estimators sufficient to identify the proposed transition.
D_c, C_e, A_c and G_V are not operationalized in this file.
Delta A_residual lacks baseline, horizon, construct definition and causal-attribution protocol here.
The asserted dependency chain and claim of non-independence are not empirically validated or converted into corpus topology by this parse.
Repository slugs are explicit source locators but immutable endpoint identity and edge authorization remain unresolved at this stage.
Framework separates observable transitions from causal explanations.
A theory should first define what changes, then propose why the change occurs.
Observable is error trajectory after consequence signals.
Named test: Correctability Benchmark / Error Persistence Test.
Does the system modify representation when fixed optimization reaches a limit?
Observable: persistent residuals followed by structural change.
Does the system modify the mechanism responsible for adaptation?
Observable: persistent change to the update process itself.
Named test: Causal Transition & Representation Evolution (CTRE).
Does the system leave downstream systems more capable after removal?
Observable: capability after deletion compared to baseline.
Adaptive systems are proposed to remain stable only when reachability expansion remains coupled to correction capacity.
Recursive adaptation is proposed to occur when consequences modify mechanisms generating future adaptation.
Framework says validation depends on adaptive transitions being measurable, reproducible and falsifiable rather than theoretically elegant.
Correctability Benchmark / Error Persistence Test is named without task family, intervention schedule, estimator, threshold or decision protocol.
Persistent residual followed by structural change does not by itself identify representation insufficiency or establish that the structural change caused improvement.
CTRE is named without local operational criteria for novelty, persistence, mechanism identity or causal attribution; endpoint identity is not resolved.
Deletion baseline, capability construct, measurement horizon, confound control and causal attribution for residual agency are unspecified.
dOmega/dt, Theta and C lack common units, estimators and an operational stability criterion here; dimensional validity of the inequality is not established.
D_c, C_e, A_c and G_V lack estimators, scales and a causal identification protocol.
The file specifies validation principles and tests but reports no executed benchmark, empirical result, negative result or replication outcome.
Measurability, reproducibility and falsifiability are requirements stated by the source, not demonstrated properties on the frozen R25 surface.
